title: Chase Not Sending OTP Verification Text: How to Fix 2FA SMS Failures [2026]
content:
Two-factor authentication (2FA) is mandatory for safeguarding your online banking credentials. However, if you are attempting to sign in and Chase states **"We've sent a code to your mobile number"** but your phone receives nothing, you are facing an SMS delivery failure.

This issue is rarely a Chase outage; rather, it typically stems from cellular carrier shortcode filtering, device spam shields, or unsupported virtual phone numbers.

## Why Are Chase Security Verification Codes Not Delivering?

**Chase OTP texts fail to arrive when your cellular carrier blocks commercial shortcodes, when your number is flagged as a VoIP/virtual line, or when iOS/Android spam filters intercept the message.** Chase utilizes automated 5-digit shortcodes that require unhindered network delivery.

| Diagnostic Detail | Information |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Bank** | Chase Bank (JPMorgan Chase) |
| **Chase Shortcode** | `24273` (CHASE) |
| **Affected Carriers** | T-Mobile, Verizon, AT&T, Mint Mobile, Cricket |
| **Average Resolution Time** | 2 - 4 Minutes |

> ⚠️ **Security Alert:** Chase only sends official verification SMS texts from official 5-digit shortcodes such as **24273**. Never respond to security codes arriving from personal 10-digit telephone numbers.

## 6 Step-by-Step Fixes When Chase Won't Send Verification Codes

Follow these solutions in order to re-establish two-factor verification delivery:

### 1. Send "HELP" or "UNSTOP" to Chase Shortcode 24273
If you previously texted "STOP" to any bank notification, your cellular carrier will permanently blacklist incoming automated messages from that shortcode:
1. Open the **Messages** app on your phone.
2. Compose a new text message to recipient: `24273`.
3. Type the word **HELP** or **UNSTOP** and press Send.
4. If you receive a reply stating *"Chase Alerts service is active,"* the carrier block is cleared. Return to your login screen and request a new code.

### 2. Check Carrier Shortcode Blocking (T-Mobile, AT&T, Verizon)
Many mobile carriers activate automated shortcode blocking by default to protect users against spam charges:
* **T-Mobile:** Log into your T-Mobile account online, navigate to **Profile** > **Block content**, and verify that **"Block Short Codes"** is toggled **Off**.
* **Verizon:** In the My Verizon app, go to **Account** > **Manage Blocks** and disable shortcode restrictions.
* **AT&T:** Call 611 and ask customer care to enable "Premium SMS and Shortcode Delivery."


> 💡 **Related Chase Bank Solution:** Encountering related issues? Check our verified fix for [Chase 2FA Phone Number Dropdown Blank or Missing: Root Cause & How to Fix](/guides/chase-verification-phone-number-dropdown-blank).


### 3. Check "Filtered & Unknown Senders" on iPhone and Android
Your smartphone’s built-in operating system may have silently quarantined the message as commercial spam:
* **iPhone (iOS):** Open **Settings** > **Messages**. Scroll down to **Filter Unknown Senders**. Check the **Junk / Unknown** tab inside your Messages app.
* **Android:** Open the **Google Messages** app, tap your **Profile Icon** > **Spam & blocked**, and check for trapped messages from `24273`.

### 4. Choose "Call Me" Instead of Text Verification
When SMS networks degrade, phone call verification routes through an entirely different telecommunication gateway:
1. On the Chase login verification screen, tap the option that says **"Choose another way to verify"** or **"Need another way?"**.
2. Select **Phone Call** instead of Text Message.
3. Keep your phone line free; Chase’s automated voice synthesizer will call your number within 15 seconds with the 6-digit PIN.

### 5. Verify Your Phone Number Is Not VoIP or Virtual
Chase strictly enforces financial safety regulations prohibiting virtual or VoIP numbers:
* Services like **Google Voice, Skype, TextNow, and MagicJack** are systematically blacklisted from receiving Chase security codes.
* Ensure the phone number on file is an authentic postpaid or prepaid SIM-based cellular line registered in your legal name.

### 6. Switch to Chase Mobile App Push Authenticator
The most reliable and phishing-resistant way to verify your identity is through direct in-app prompts:
1. Ensure the **Chase Mobile App** is installed on your primary smartphone.
2. Enable **Push Notifications** for Chase in your phone settings.
3. During future desktop sign-ins, select **"Send Push Notification to My Phone"** to approve logins with a single tap, bypassing SMS entirely.

## How to Check Official Chase Server Status

If thousands of banking customers are simultaneously reporting missing OTPs, Chase’s telecommunication gateway partner (Twilio/Syniverse) may be suffering an outage.
* Check [@ChaseSupport](https://twitter.com/ChaseSupport) on X for updates.
* Check Downdetector's live map for Chase SMS delivery reports.

## Prevention Tips

To ensure you are never [locked out](/guides/chase-account-locked-suspicious-activity) of your account during critical banking tasks:
* **Add a Backup Number:** Add both a mobile number and a secondary home or office landline in your Chase profile.
* **Keep Mobile Push Active:** Always keep the Chase app installed and verified on your smartphone for zero-friction 2FA.
* **Never Use VPNs When Requesting 2FA:** Disguised IP addresses often trigger higher security thresholds that require secondary authorization.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Why am I receiving codes from other apps but not from Chase?**
**Standard apps often send SMS through regular 10-digit peer-to-peer numbers, whereas Chase utilizes dedicated enterprise 5-digit shortcodes.** If your carrier profile has shortcode blocking enabled, only shortcode messages are intercepted.

**How long is a Chase verification code valid?**
**Chase one-time passcodes expire after exactly 10 minutes.** If you request multiple codes, only the most recently generated PIN will be accepted by the authentication server.

**Can a Chase customer service representative tell me my OTP over the phone?**
**No.** Legitimate Chase representatives have zero access to your one-time passwords for security compliance reasons. Never trust anyone asking for this code.

**What should I do if I am travelling abroad and can't receive SMS?**
**If you are outside the United States, connect to hotel Wi-Fi and use the Chase Mobile App's push notification approval.** Alternatively, call the international collect number on the back of your debit card for manual verification.
